{{Top|ca|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|I doubt it, unless you can alter time and speed up the harvest. Or else teleport me off this sandpile under Uncle Owen's nose.''"<br />"''I don't think so, sir. I'm only a third-degree 'droid and not very knowledgeable about such things as transatomic physics.|Luke Skywalker and C-3PO|<ref name="ANHN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Transatomic physics''' was a field of knowledge involving [[Time travel/Legends|time travel]] and [[Teleportation (Force power)/Legends|teleportation]].<ref name="ANHN" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'' novelization]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] asked if he could help the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmboy]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Skywalker expressed skepticism and stated the only way C-3PO could help was to alter [[Time/Legends|time]] or teleport him away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] without the knowledge of his [[Lars family/Legends|uncle]] [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]. C-3PO responded by saying that, as he was only a [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]], he did not know much about subjects like transatomic physics.<ref name="ANHN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Transatomic physics was mentioned in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars saga|film]] [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANHN" /> released in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
